title: Add Two Numbers
description:
Write a program that reads two whole numbers (one per line) and prints their sum.

Example: inputs `7` and `3` print `10`.
starter_code:
a = input()
b = input()
# Convert to numbers, add them and print the sum
hints: `input()` returns text. Convert with `int()` before adding.
solution_code:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())
print(a + b)
